entities.summary: Jasmin Fazlić, known by his stage name Jala Brat, is a Bosnian rapper, songwriter, and record producer. He has released several studio albums and is known for collaborating with another Bosnian rapper Buba Corelli, with whom he founded the record label Imperia.
